newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady as CAB postpones meet.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady as CAB postpones meet.

text.p: Cotton prices held steady in a narrow price band on Friday, dealers said.

New crop arrivals in the Punjab region fell to 20/22 thousand bales (170 kg each) against earlier daily average of 28/30 thousand bales. In the spot deals Bengal-deshi was quiet at 885/910 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned was steady at 1,540/1,640 rupees per maund.
Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) was steady at 18,000/19,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).

"Meeting of the Cotton Advisory Board (which was scheduled yesterday) was postponed at the last moment due to delay in the assessment of new crop amid recent unseasonal rain in the producing centres," said Chandulal Thakkar, a leading dealer.
He said the meeting will be held in midthe middle of next month," he anticipated.
